Name: More Brain Exercise by Namco
Description: Namco's brain-training sequel. Work through frontal, temporal and parietal lobe minigames to lower your Brain Age, keep a daily training streak going, and unlock a full Sudoku mode.

Achievements.Name: I Am Everything
Achievements.Description: Be awarded at least "Solar System" rank in all games on Hard mode.

Achievements.Name: Coming Back For More
Achievements.Description: Complete Brain Training 3 days in a row.

Achievements.Name: A Week Of Hard Work
Achievements.Description: Complete Brain Training 7 days in a row.

Achievements.Name: Scrupulous
Achievements.Description: Complete Brain Training 30 days in a row.

Achievements.Name: Frontman
Achievements.Description: Be awarded 100 points for Frontal lobe exercises.

Achievements.Name: It's Not Temporary
Achievements.Description: Be awarded 100 points for Temporal lobe exercises.

Achievements.Name: Party Time
Achievements.Description: Be awarded 100 points for Parietal lobe exercises.

Achievements.Name: Mindblowing
Achievements.Description: Be awarded 100 points for each lobe area.

Achievements.Name: Forever Young
Achievements.Description: Be awarded a maximum Brain Age of 25 for three consecutive days.

Achievements.Name: Sudoku Rookie
Achievements.Description: Solve a Sudoku puzzle on Easy.

Achievements.Name: Sudoku Apprentice
Achievements.Description: Solve a Sudoku puzzle on Medium.

Achievements.Name: Sudoku Master
Achievements.Description: Solve a Sudoku puzzle on Hard.
